title: The Watershed: Where Rain Becomes Runoff
description: Define a catchment, trace D8 flow paths across a SYNTHETIC 3-D terrain (depression-filled, drop/distance routing, stream network from flow accumulation), then turn rainfall into runoff with an executable rational-method cell and an SCS curve-number cell.

citation.text: O'Callaghan, J.F. & Mark, D.M. (1984). The extraction of drainage networks from digital elevation data. Comput. Vision Graph. Image Process., 28(3), 323–344.

author: Mohammad Galib, Purdue University
